name: Black-Bile Congregation
identity: Bloated plague-knights, shambling pox-carriers and rot-engines. Slow and very hard to kill; an armour-rotting aura grows each round (3″ → 6″ → 9″), so the longer the battle goes, the worse it is to stand near them.

rules.name: Aura of Rust & Rot · Bloated Resilience
rules.description: Enemy units within Contagion Range of any Black-Bile unit have −1 ARM (not cumulative). Contagion Range: 3″ in Round 1, 6″ in Round 2, 9″ from Round 3. Black-Bile units (except [EXPENDABLE] ones) have UNYIELDING 5+.

rules.name: Gamble — Rupture the Blight-Sacs
rules.description: When a unit activates: each enemy unit within 3″ suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+. That Black-Bile unit loses UNYIELDING for the rest of the battle. (Risk: durability (permanent).)

detachments.name: Infected Ground
detachments.playstyle: Take objectives, rot them, walk on.

rules.name: Corrupted Objectives
rules.description: Objectives you control are [SECURED] and emit a 3″ Contagion aura (−1 ARM) until an enemy controls them.

enhancements.name: Censer of Rot
enhancements.description: **Lord of Black Bile** only. The attached unit has UNYIELDING 5+ even if ruptured.

stratagems.name: Fester
stratagems.effect: An enemy unit within 3″ of a corrupted objective suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.

stratagems.name: Rot from Within
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit takes an objective you corrupted

detachments.name: Death-Blister Brotherhood
detachments.playstyle: Melee hordes that punish anything that fights them.

rules.name: Spreaders of Filth
rules.description: Every Black-Bile model destroyed in melee inflicts 1 Fatal Wound on the attacking unit on a 5+.

enhancements.name: Plague-Bell
enhancements.description: **Pox-Physician** only. Friendly Class 1 units within 6″ get +1 Attack in melee on a round they charged.

stratagems.name: Burst Open
stratagems.turn: A unit is destroyed in melee
stratagems.effect: Every enemy unit within 3″ suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.

stratagems.name: Shambling Tide
stratagems.turn: A Class 1 unit declares a Charge

stratagems.name: Endless Pox
stratagems.effect: Return a destroyed Pox-Carriers unit at half strength within 6″ of your table edge.

detachments.name: Smog Engines
detachments.playstyle: Daemon-engines and drones behind a curtain of filth.

rules.name: Smog and Smoke
rules.description: Friendly Class 1–2 units within 9″ of a Black-Bile Class 3–5 unit are [STEALTH] against attacks from more than 12″.

stratagems.name: Choking Clouds
stratagems.turn: An enemy unit within 9″ of a Class 3–5 unit Shoots

stratagems.name: Rusted Ram
stratagems.turn: A Class 4 unit ends a Charge
